recommendations.issue: Seeds 56 and 57 use same English pattern with different Japanese verbs
recommendations.fix: Rewrite seed 57 to clearly indicate 'recall' vs seed 56's 'retention'. Example: 'I can't recall how to say' vs 'I can remember how to say'

recommendations.issue: Only 4 seeds between first use of 思い出す and first use of 覚える
recommendations.fix: Move 覚える introduction later (after seed 20 at minimum) to allow 思い出す pattern to stabilize

recommendations.issue: Three variants (勉強する, 覚える, 学ぶ) creates complexity
recommendations.fix: Establish clear chunked patterns: 'learn a language' = 勉強する, 'learn/memorize words' = 覚える, 'learn something' = 学ぶ

recommendations.issue: Good disambiguation but could be more explicit
recommendations.fix: Always use 'I think that...' = と思う, 'think about X' = Xについて考える

recommendations.issue: Only あげる introduced so far
recommendations.fix: Plan introduction of くれる (receiving) and もらう (getting) with clear chunked contexts
